_doc: Drop this at .claude/settings.json in a consuming repo (merge if one exists).
The plugin cannot ship the permissions block itself — plugin settings.json
supports only `agent` and `subagentStatusLine`, so the deny list must live
in the project. It is the backstop for the protect-branches hook: the hook
blocks pushes, the deny list blocks merges.
The two plugin keys make the factory load automatically for anyone who
clones this repo and trusts it — no manual `claude plugin install`.
Remove this _doc key before committing if you prefer.
